summary: ```# Marvelous Designer Official - 2023 User Conference: BenQ Professional Designer Monitor Introduction ## Introduction Whether it is to produce complex costume effects or to pursue the details of the display, I believe that everyone can gain knowledge from the sharing just now. Since we are talking about details, it is not just the software that will help everyone continuously evolve their works; the hardware equipment also needs to meet our creative needs. Mingji's professional design display is developed and launched for the needs of all kinds of designers. Next, let's welcome the channel manager of Mingji Shanghai, Mr. Tan Yachuan, to introduce the Mingji professional display. ## Speaker Introduction Thank you. Good afternoon, everyone. I am the channel manager of the Mingji professional design display. Today, I will share with you the contents of the Mingji PD series professional design display. ## Purpose of the PD Series First of all, the first question is, why are we here? This is the MD user interface. Why are we here? Actually, our PD and MD have the same purpose. MD is Marvelous Designer. Our PD is Professional Designer. We are all a brand built for professional designers. The Mingji PD series professional design display is based on over 20 years of professional display experience. Since 2013, we have focused on the field of design display, striving to create a high-efficiency tool for our designers. Our involvement in the industry includes organizing and participating in various forums, and even leading the development of the industry. We hope to create a platform for professional designers to showcase their ideas and express themselves. We also aim to promote the transformation from China to China. ## Importance of Display for Designers For most designers, the display is a tool they frequently interact with. It is the most important display device. Next, I will show you a short video demonstrating how the display interacts with our daily work and lives. How does Mingji help you through the display? What kind of display does a designer need? For a designer, if the color is not accurate, the effort is in vain. In the eyes of ordinary people, a single black and white gray may represent a hundred kinds of black and white gray in the eyes of a designer. A cracked screen may have color differences and unevenness. ## Features of Mingji PD2705U As a professional design display, there must be strict selection standards. The Mingji BenQ PD2705U uses a variety of strict testing criteria. We choose a panel with color stability and efficiency and equip it with Mingji's unique AQColor color adjustment to ensure that each display meets industry color standards. This allows designers to worry less about color differences. The color unevenness often creates challenges for designers, making it difficult to achieve a consistent work-to-work connection. Mingji PD2705U ensures that the screen is evenly controlled, with adjustments made to more than 25 areas of the screen separately to reduce differences in color and brightness. This ensures accuracy and consistency in image display. It is also the first professional design display that has been certified by Pantone in the current market. A common misunderstanding is that a display should be brighter and better. However, when displaying SD20, turning the brightness too high can lead to discoloration of the production content and can also strain the eyes. The correct usage method is to adjust the brightness to an appropriate value before use. ## Design and Ergonomics To satisfy the picky eyes of designers, the appearance features a simple cylinder-shaped frame design, which can be easily adjusted. The flat base provides designers with more desk space. The external controller, HOT K-POD, places shortcut keys in the user's hand, allowing for the use of the most commonly utilized professional design modes to help capture consumer inspiration. The professional design display of PD2705U is tailored to the designer's perspective, showcasing accurate color, which is consistent with the BenQ PD series of professional design. ## Addressing Color Differences We previously discussed important shortcomings. The primary concern for designers is the color difference. What is the color difference? In our industry, it refers to the discrepancy between the display's color and the standard color, described by Delta E (ΔE). The smaller the difference, the better. In the industry, a professional-grade display is generally considered to have a Delta E within the range of 1 to 3, but we always strive to ensure it is within the range of 1 to 2. Thus, our system is designed to ensure the accurate output of our display from the beginning, addressing the most fundamental problem for designers. ## Color Modes Available We have prepared four color modes for our designers: 1. **Animation Design Mode**: This mode supports brightness adjustments from 0 to 10, which is self-defined. When brightness is adjusted, it will not be excessively high, preserving and showcasing more layers. 2. **Dual Color Mode**: This mode allows the same screen to be divided into two areas—one side in sRGB mode and the other in animation design mode. This is practical for designers editing videos under P3 while also displaying the user viewing effect in normal sRGB. 3. **Dark Mode**: Designed for environments with low ambient light, this mode optimizes brightness and contrast to enhance image detail in dark settings. 4. **CAD and CAM Mode**: This mode enhances the brightness and contrast of lines and images, making details clearer and sharper, significantly reducing eye fatigue. ## Additional Features We also have the **MAC Look Mode**, which considers the daily lives of designers who predominantly use Apple products. This mode allows for seamless integration with Apple devices, ensuring color consistency across the displays. Furthermore, the **KVM** functionality allows for control of multiple main machines with a single keyboard, making it convenient for designers who work with both desktop and laptop systems. Lastly, the **CorridorNet** feature provides smart eye protection with four modes, ensuring the well-being of designers during extended use. ## Feedback and Conclusion We have invited several industry experts to experience our products. For instance, Sun Junqing, a well-known color-adjusting expert, remarked on the strict color requirements of our display, describing it as a faithful and reliable tool. Currently, we have nine models in our entire CorridorNet series, available in various sizes to meet different design needs, including our 34-inch large variant. Lastly, I would like to share some information regarding our new fire system, which invites more designers to experience our high-tech activities. Please pay attention to the two QR codes displayed: one for our assistant, a wind turbine design for our private display, which provides a voucher for our products, and the other for updates on our new fire project. Thank you for your attention. My speech concludes here. ```
